claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Benzoxiquine is a 8-hydroxyquinoline antiinfective with no annotated anticancer target; at 2.5 uM it most plausibly causes weak, non-selective cytotoxicity via metal chelation and/or cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than a specific oncogenic pathway.
